info.name: FitSphere Member App API v1
info.description:
**Splash first:** `GET {{baseUrl}}/config?alias=<appAlias>` (no auth) → logo, theme, features, ads.

Member mobile APIs for Stitch FitZone screens.

**Base:** `{{host}}/api/v1/app`

**Envelope**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "string",
  "data": {},
  "meta": {}
}
```

**Error**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "...",
  "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "errors": {}
}
```

Each request includes a saved **Example response** (Success) so the app team can generate DTOs.

Demo: `member@demo.com` / `Member@123`

item.name: App Config (Splash)
item.description: First call on app launch — no auth. Pass gym `alias` (white-label app id). Returns logo, theme, feature flags, ads.

request.description:
**Required query:** `alias` (gym appAlias).

Also accepts `slug` / `code` as fallbacks.

Use this on splash before login to paint logo, colors, and decide which modules/ads to show.
